admission.justification: A future test cleanup must not silently replace real public-answer coverage with lighter synthetic answers while retaining its provenance claim.

alternatives.option: Keep the captured real public answers as the retained controls data regardless of preferred fixture weight.
alternatives.reason: Appendix151 explicitly accepts actual response weight. l86.test-utils loads the complete captured JSON rather than selecting/trimming its fields and checks the invariant-selector request against the member capture.

alternatives.option: Trim or manufacture smaller substitute answers merely to meet a preferred fixture weight while calling them the retained real captures.
alternatives.reason: That would change the exercised answer and falsely carry the original public-response provenance onto synthetic data.
alternatives.reconsider_when: An approved requirement changes the retained control strategy and separately identifies synthetic coverage versus newly authenticated actual response captures.

consequences: A future test cleanup must not silently replace real public-answer coverage with lighter synthetic answers while retaining its provenance claim.
The helper does not authenticate every historical capture hash, prove a native producer run, or prohibit explicitly declared synthetic unit tests elsewhere.
context: Approved MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6 require this by-design choice to be recorded, not deferred as a gap. Source obligation: MIK-R57@v2 by-design real-captures. This is the requirement-prescribed boundary, not a claim that an undocumented alternative was seriously weighed.
decider: Approved MIK-R57@v2 under D18/D47/D48; Curator records the specified boundary under constrains_future_work.
